english: Let $f:[0,5]\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=\min\left\{\{x\},\,\dfrac{|x-3|}{3}\right\}$, where $\{t\}=t-[t]$ and $[t]$ denotes the greatest integer less than or equal to $t$. Then the value of $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{5}f(x)\,dx$ is ______.
hindi: माना कि $f:[0,5]\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=\min\left\{\{x\},\,\dfrac{|x-3|}{3}\right\}$ द्वारा परिभाषित है, जहाँ $\{t\}=t-[t]$ तथा $[t]$, $t$ से कम या उसके बराबर महत्तम पूर्णांक को दर्शाता है। तब $\displaystyle\int_{0}^{5}f(x)\,dx$ का मान ______ है।
solution: On $[n,n+1)$, $\{x\}=x-n$; the line $\frac{|x-3|}{3}$ meets it at $x=\frac34,\frac32,\frac94$ (left of $3$) and $\frac92$ (right of $3$)
solution_full: On each $[n,n+1)$, $\{x\}=x-n$, a line rising from $0$ to $1$. The other function is $g(x)=\frac{3-x}{3}$ for $x\le3$ and $g(x)=\frac{x-3}{3}$ for $x\ge3$. By additivity integrate over the five unit intervals, splitting each where $x-n=g(x)$.

$[0,1)$: $x=\frac{3-x}{3}\iff x=\frac34$. For $x<\frac34$ the minimum is $x$, after it $1-\frac x3$. Integral $=\frac12\cdot\frac{9}{16}+\left[x-\frac{x^{2}}{6}\right]_{3/4}^{1}=\frac{9}{32}+\frac{17}{96}=\frac{11}{24}$.
$[3,4)$: $\frac{x-3}{3}\le x-3$ throughout, so the minimum is $\frac{x-3}{3}$; integral $=\frac16$.
originality_note: New: the minimum of the sawtooth {x} and a slow V-shaped line |x-3|/3, whose crossing points move inside each tooth (way 2). Closest known: int min({x}, 1 - {x}) dx and int |x - a| dx. Different because: the crossing point is different in each unit interval and the V changes direction at x = 3.
blueprint_concepts: Definite integrals of GIF and fractional part functions
Definite integrals with modulus and max / min integrands

concept_use.Definite integrals of GIF and fractional: {x} = x - n on each unit interval sets up the five pieces.
concept_use.Definite integrals with modulus and max: min{{x}, |x-3|/3} switches at x = 3/4, 3/2, 9/4, 9/2, and the modulus changes form at x = 3.

stem_review: Read as a student: f on [0,5] with {t}, [t] defined; checked piecewise with sympy and by quadrature: 3/2. Answer 1.50, a positive decimal as planned. Changed: No change.
key_step: Locate the crossing x - n = |x-3|/3 in each unit interval and add triangle and trapezium areas.
justification: Routine but careful casework over five pieces with exact fractions; nothing non-standard. Same demand as 2021-P1-Q2 (L2).
